'''Bas van Zuilen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dutch National Championship]] on 21 May 2000 with Carbon Freezing testing, according to Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d791">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championships-ryloth-21-05-2000d791/ dutch-championships-ryloth-21-05-2000], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 22 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championships-ryloth-21-05-2000d791/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
